title: Conversation 2026-10-28: PR flow, getting work able to merge

sections.name: summary
sections.label: Summary
sections.content: The owner had spent two hours unpicking PRs and asked to look at the flow work in srs-programme. Agent reading of PR history 2026-10-26..28: srs-programme PRs merge within the hour, srs and srs-rust PRs wait ~17h and most carry follow-up commits. Three causes: strict 'require up to date' branch protection plus a quorum tied to the exact head stalls working-group PRs (upkeep never updates them, clerk lib/practice/upkeep.mjs:92); sibling tasks of one issue run in parallel and append to one file (srs#979/#980/#981, conformance/arrangement/scenarios.json); duplicate issues produce duplicate PRs (srs-rust#1470 and #1498 fix the same ADR-011 bullet). Suggested: problem SP-124, findings, remedies (quorum survives a base merge; a sequence frees its next task only when the previous merges; append-heavy fixtures get one file per entry). Cleanup: srs-rust#1470 closed as superseded, srs#980 rebased.
